learner_operation: Normalize the first pivot of a nonsingular 2x2 augmented matrix, eliminate its lower-left entry, normalize the second pivot, and optionally back-substitute to solve x,y.

fixed_features.feature: Nonsingular 2x3 augmented matrix, nonzero first pivot, normalized forward REF, optional solve and five radio choices
fixed_features.justification: Canonical 0a9e6824 and tutorial 2112d3af establish pivot normalization, elimination and back substitution; complete source banks have five choices.

fixed_features.feature: Ten coefficient profiles, bounded RHS scaling and target shifts
fixed_features.justification: Conservative finite same-operation arithmetic family preserves source denominator workload; supports focused practice, not arbitrary-matrix transfer. Nothing in the source fixes candidate rank in a delivered subgroup.

answer_roles.role: Correct lower-right value, corresponding x,y and radio option
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Each candidate may qualify when the lower input RHS changes; option order can independently permute.
answer_roles.observed: All five ranks per profile before/after catalog rejection; actual batch q-73439 retains rank zero exclusively, 3/3.

coverage.case: Exact runner batch before and after delivery
coverage.result: 5/5 accepted; three scaled q-73439 instances all select minimum lower-right value.

counterfactuals.change: Hold profile, scale, bank/order, first input row and coefficients fixed; change lower input RHS across targets 0 through 4.
counterfactuals.expected: Each of five different choices becomes correct; prompt, solution and native acceptance follow.
counterfactuals.observed: Ten profiles each reach five different answers; exact readbacks and native grader agree. Actual-UI renders include easy endpoint pairs and a moderate pair.
counterfactuals.justification: Tutorial 2112d3af Step 2 changes the augmented column along with coefficient columns; lower RHS determines normalized y.

counterfactuals.change: Change seed to permute options while profile, scale and target stay fixed.
counterfactuals.expected: Same matrix, solution and mathematical key; native acceptance follows choice identity.
counterfactuals.observed: Ten permutations preserve prompt and key value; every option checked in native grader. Representative permutation rendered.
counterfactuals.justification: Choice order is incidental to Gaussian elimination and the one-choice radio contract.

shortcut_probes.strategy: If input a11=1 choose second-largest candidate lower-right value; otherwise choose smallest. Ignore input RHS and row elimination.
shortcut_probes.conclusion: 4/4 versus random radio baseline 1/5. delivery.result: 5/5 batch records survive, retaining conditional minimum-choice shortcut. Independent samples accept 28/36 easy and 37/45 moderate. Selection cannot supply absent target ranks within this subgroup. Unit-pivot branch plus minimum/second-largest rule answers all five delivered items. Captured-plus-proposed pool and old-seen/new-fresh scenarios analyzed; the latter leaves this exact five-question pool. No claim of a universal shortcut over the mixed old inventory.

limitations: Demonstrated batch-selection defect, not a universal decision_instance defect; controlled ranks refute a universal minimum rule.
